svg.aria-label: Horizontal flowchart of the Deterministic Bounding Procedure: initialize, solve the follower at the proposed tax, update the incumbent, add the additional constraint, re-solve the high point relaxation, then test whether the bound gap still exceeds epsilon. If it does, a stagnation counter is updated and the loop either terminates with the incumbent or iterates again. If the gap has closed, a test on whether the master re-proposes the same leader decision decides between terminating with an optimal solution and terminating with an epsilon-optimal solution.
svg.title: Deterministic Bounding Procedure — control flow and termination
svg.desc: The procedure alternates between the high point relaxation with additional constraints, which proposes a carbon tax and yields one bound, and an exact follower solve at that tax, which yields the other bound and a new additional constraint. Once the bound gap falls within the optimality tolerance, a test on whether the master re-proposes the same leader decision decides whether the reported solution is optimal or only epsilon-optimal. A stagnation counter provides an auxiliary termination when neither bound moves for twenty consecutive iterations.
